steps.title: Download the Steam installer for Mac
steps.explanation: Click the Install Steam button on the page to download the Steam app for Mac.

steps.title: Open the downloaded file and drag Steam to Applications
steps.explanation: Open the downloaded file from your Downloads folder. Drag the Steam icon into the Applications folder.

steps.title: Open Steam and sign in
steps.explanation: Open Steam from your Applications folder. Sign in with your account, or create a new one.
